plan.summary: This first 4-week block is a simple off-camp build for boxing with one focused weekly session. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body lift so later percentage work has a reference, and the main training begins in Week 2. With only one S&C session per week and minimal home equipment, the plan keeps power first, then strength, then trunk and short conditioning so you build useful force without taking too much away from boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build basic strength and general power with simple movements that are easy to recover from alongside boxing.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main strength and power work while trimming unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it faster with sharper, lower-fatigue power and speed work.

exercises.name: Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Jump as high as you can on every rep. Reset between reps and land softly with control.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if space is tight. Start from a still position and focus on a crisp takeoff.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a low stable box and step down each rep. Prioritize clean landings over box height.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Use this session to establish your starting strength level. Warm up gradually, then work up to one hard but clean set of 3-5 reps with the heaviest load you can manage with solid form and no grinding.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can set your training numbers for the next block.

substitutionOptions.name: Double Dumbbell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the goblet position limits load before your legs are challenged.

substitutionOptions.name: Kettlebell Front Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use one or two kettlebells if that setup feels more stable.

performanceTarget.prompt: Log your best clean top set so later weeks can build from it.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.notes: Leave 1-2 clean reps in reserve. Keep ribs down, move as one piece, and pause briefly at the bottom.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if full push-ups are not yet clean for all reps.

substitutionOptions.name: Dumbbell Floor Press
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if wrists or shoulders prefer a neutral grip.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Pull toward the hip, pause briefly at the top, and keep the torso stable.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you want more support and less low-back involvement.

substitutionOptions.name: Backpack Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a loaded backpack if dumbbells are limited.

exercises.name: Front Plank
exercises.notes: Brace hard, squeeze glutes, and keep the body long and still.

substitutionOptions.name: Ab Wheel Rollout
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you have the equipment and can keep the ribs down.

substitutionOptions.name: Body Saw Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use sliders or towels and keep the range small and controlled.

exercises.name: Conditioning Intervals
exercises.notes: Move continuously but under control. Keep breathing steady and posture tall.

endurancePrescription.adjustment: If boxing training was hard this week, do 6 rounds instead of 8.
